25. INVESTMENTS IN SUBSIDIARIES (CONTD.)
(a) Acquisition of additional interest in subsidiaries - 2025/26
During the year, the Group acquired additional equity interests in certain subsidiaries from non-controlling shareholders. As the
Group already held control over these entities, the transactions were accounted for as equity transactions in accordance with
SLFRS 10 – Consolidated Financial Statements. The carrying amounts of the non-controlling interests were adjusted to reflect
the change in ownership, with the difference between the consideration paid and the adjustment to NCI recognised directly in
equity. Details of the acquisitions are as follows:

(c) Interests in Other Entities
Bukit Darah PLC consolidates Carson Cumberbatch PLC (“CCPLC”), its sole direct subsidiary and the holding entity of all
operations within the Carsons Group. As CCPLC represents the full scope of the Group’s activities, Bukit Darah PLC complies
with SLFRS 12 – Disclosure of Interests in Other Entities by presenting key information related to CCPLC.
Disclosures include:
- Ownership and voting rights held by non-controlling interests
- Profit or loss attributable to non-controlling interests
- Accumulated non-controlling interests at the reporting date
- Summarised financial information of CCPLC
